_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (6% for ±2 moves) plus flat funding, mid F&G, and two-sided fragility make HOLD the skilled call until a clear breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split: analyst explicit HOLD in Disbelief; narrative blowoff/outflow tone leans risk-off but does not name a forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 50-62, funding near midpoint, 30d momentum still sub-parabolic
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G and momentum both clear 63 with funding lift (Hope), or vol/gold spike and price break push F&G under 47 (Complacency or lower)
